deadline.quote: The equal consideration deadline for undergraduate applications is 13 January 2027 (6 pm, UK time) in your planned entry year.

tuition.quote: International students, £34,700 for the first year.

scholarship_exists.quote: Think Big is the University of Bristol’s flagship scholarship scheme, providing funding towards tuition fees for international students studying eligible undergraduate or postgraduate courses.
scholarship_exists.notes: Tuition-fee support only (FULL_TUITION at most, usually PARTIAL); competitive; the page describes the September 2026 entry cycle (applications closed 10 April 2026), 2027 cycle not yet published. Medicine and Dentistry excluded.
